newsitem.title: INDIA: Italy's Fiat plans new car for India.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Fiat plans new car for India.

text.p: Italy's Fiat Spa is planning to introduce another car in addition to its existing Uno model on Indian roads, a senior executive said on Tuesday.

"We are doing a feasibility study to produce in India a new range of cars suitable for the Indian market," Franco Pilastro, President Fiat International, said while addressing a meeting of industrialists in New Delhi.
Pilastro is one of the representatives of several global firms participating in "Destination India", a two-day symposium of global investors which began in the Indian capital on Tuesday.
The Italian car maker has a technical tie-up with India's Premier Automobiles Limited to make and sell Uno cars.
Pilastro said the group was planning to enter into other sectors including industrial components, metallurgical products and chemicals.
"There are many Fiat companies that are looking for joint ventures," he said.
Pilastro said Magnetti Marelli, Fiat Ferroviaria, Fiat Impresit and SNIA were some of the Fiat firms that are studying opportunities to enter India.
